summary: Black home shirt presented 21 July 2026. No front-of-shirt sponsor: launch photos and the club shop's match-shirt mock-ups show an empty chest (sports.ru, 21 Jul 2026; footbolno.ru table updated 29 Sep 2026 also lists 'none' for Akron). LADA is on the sleeve and Электрощит Самара on the back per the club shop's match-shirt mock-ups; the other sleeve carries the RPL league patch; shorts carry only the club crest and the club's АКРОН wordmark.
